observations: The complete formula has install logic but no test block or disable! declaration. No source or build evidence supports dependency or platform findings.

findings.reason: The complete formula ends after installation without a test block, so its command execution behavior is not exercised.
findings.verification: Add a functional test that runs the installed watch command with a bounded lifetime, executes a command that writes a temporary marker, and asserts that the marker was created; then run brew test visionmedia-watch on an appropriate Homebrew machine.
